title: The Bench That Could Slide
youtube_title: The Bench That Could Slide | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a little can make two people feel expected.
summary: At a courtyard supper with a long table and a fig tree, Milo sees that a bench that could slide to make one more seat will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Milo makes a smaller, even share so Yara is included, and Grandpa Sol lets the choice stand without a speech.
